meta.name: English
app.title: Data Vault
app.tagline: Your details for forms – enter them once, kept safe on this device.
app.disclaimer: Help with filling in forms. Not legal advice. Please check all details.
lang.label: Language
welcome.p1: Store the details that many forms ask for: name, address, family, rent, income.
welcome.p2: Everything stays on this device and is encrypted. The app needs no internet and no account.
setup.p: You will open your vault with this passphrase. Use several words that are easy for you to remember, for example: sun bicycle kitchen 7
pass.mismatch: The two entries are not the same.
rec.p: If you forget your passphrase, this code is the only way back to your data. Write it on paper and keep it safe. Nobody else has this code, not even us.
rec.check: I have written down the code.
rec.wrong: That does not match. Please look at your note.
unlock.wrong: The passphrase is wrong. Check upper and lower case.
forgot.p: Enter the code from your note and choose a new passphrase.
main.autolocked: The vault was locked automatically for your protection.
main.add.which: What would you like to add?
main.empty.haushalt: Do other people live with you? Add them here.
err.name: Please check your entry.
err.datum: Please enter the date as DD.MM.YYYY, e.g. 01.02.1985
err.betrag: Please enter the amount as a number, e.g. 512.50
err.iban: This IBAN is not valid. Please compare it with your bank card.
err.email: This e-mail address is not valid.
err.telefon: This phone number is not valid.
err.storage: Saving failed. Is the device storage full?
err.nocrypto: Secure encryption is not available here. Please open the app via an https address, as an installed app or as a file on the device.
sec.code.confirm: The old recovery code will no longer work. Continue?
rec.renew: Your recovery code has not been confirmed yet, so here is a new one. Any code shown earlier no longer works.
backup.p: Save a backup regularly, for example on a USB stick or in your files. If the browser deletes its data or the device is lost, you can restore everything with it.
backup.saved: The backup has been saved: {name}. To restore it you need your current passphrase or your recovery code.
backup.due.nie: You have no backup yet. If the browser deletes its data or the device is lost, your details are gone.
backup.due.alt: Your last backup is older than 30 days and you have changed something since.
restore.p: Choose the backup file and enter the passphrase that was valid when the backup was made.
restore.withcode: Forgot passphrase? Restore with recovery code
restore.confirm: Your current details on this device will be replaced by the backup. Continue?
restore.wrong: The passphrase does not match this backup. You need the passphrase that was valid when the backup was made.
restore.wrongcode: The recovery code does not match this backup.
restore.nofile: Please choose the backup file first.
err.backup.keine-sicherung: This is not a backup file of this app.
err.backup.neuere-version: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Please update the app.
err.backup.zu-gross: The file is too large for a backup.
main.replaced: A backup was restored in another window. Please open the vault again.
